texts.preamble: Somu Veera Venkata Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23 September, 2019 Author: U. Durga Prasad Rao Bench: U. Durga Prasad Rao Hon'Ble Sri Justice U. Durga Prasad Rao Criminal Petition No.5244 Of 2019 Order:
texts.facts: The petitioners/Accused seek to quash the proceedings against them in Crime No.124 of 2019 of Attili Police Station, West Godavari District, registered for the offences under Sections 188, 270, 273 of IPC, Section 22 of Cigarettes and Other Tobacco Products (Prohibition of Advertisement and Regulation of Trade and Commerce, Production, Supply and Distribution) Act, 2003 (for short, 'COTP Act, 2003') and Section 54 r/w.Sec.59 Food Safety and Standards Act (for short, 'FSS Act'). 2. The allegations against the petitioners briefly are that on 13.07.2019 at 10:00 a.m., when the complainant along with his staff on credible information, rushed to Railway Station road at Attili Village and Mandal , found a Mahindra Bolero bearing No. A.P 05 XH TR 6368 vehicle coming from railway station towards Attili side and while shifting prohibited Gutka and Khaini Packets in the vehicle, on suspicion, caught them and on enquiry, they came to know that they are transporting the banned tobacco products and hence, arrested the accused and seized the same and registered a case in Crime No.124 of 2019 of Attili Police Station, West Godavari District, for the offences stated supra. 3. He relied upon the order of this Court in Crl.P.Nos.3731 of 2018 and batch, dated 27.08.2018.
texts.arguments: Learned counsel for petitioners while denying the FIR allegations would submit that even if the prosecution case is accepted to be true, tobacco products would not fall within the purview of IPC and therefore, the Police are not authorized to register the crime, investigate and file charge sheet. 4. So far as the offence under Section 188 of IPC is concerned, as per Section 195(1)(a)(i) of Cr.P.C, no Court shall take cognizance of the said offence except on the complaint in writing of that Court or by such Officer of the Court as that Court may authorise in writing in this behalf, or of some other Court to which that Court is subordinate. Somu Veera Venkata Srinivasa Rao vs The State Of Andhra Pradesh on 23 September, 2019 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/77067415/ 1 5.
